_provenance: See README.md in this directory. Captured live from the installed CC harness (version 2.1.273) connecting as an MCP client to a throwaway stdio server declaring experimental["claude/channel"]. The request/response bytes are real and unmodified except clientInfo: its name, title, description and website fields named the vendor product and are replaced by the neutral token "cc-harness" / "<redacted>" (description and website removed); protocolVersion, capabilities and version are exactly as captured. No account path or session id appears in this exchange (MCP initialize carries neither).

session_init_event_excerpt._comment: From the harness's own stream-json system/init event for this same session, confirming the server connected. The harness-version key is renamed to a neutral name; its value is as captured.
